description: §19.16.5 — the TRUE intermediate case: batch 0 (the UPDATE) succeeds, the client continuation after it runs ("mid;"), then batch 1 (the INSERT) fails. The deferred bodies run exactly once, AFTER that — never when batch 0's stub returned: trace = "start;mid;D;", @busy = false. A lowering that ran the deferred body at batch 0's return would give "start;D;mid;" (or run it twice).
rationale: §19.16.5: the deferred body runs after the LAST continuation and SHALL NOT run when an earlier batch's stub returns; it also runs when an intermediate batch fails and the function returns its error envelope (§19.6.7 — batch 0's commit stands). serverStub answers batch 0 with success and batch 1 with an impl-neutral server error (`__batches`, keyed by the §19.9.9.3 batch ordinal).
